column1: # Cross-database clade/superfamily harmonization for combined classification.
# KEY = TEsorter2 runtime (order,superfamily,clade) as emitted by
# Equivalences are asserted from the literature (Neumann et al. 2019, Mob DNA
# 10:1, Table 1 for the REXdb<->GyDB lineage pairs), not fitted to any dataset.
# Contains ONLY rows that change something; absent triples are already canonical.
# lineage_h is the sub-clade level, set only where one database resolves BELOW
# the level both can express: REXdb splits the Tat group into Ogre/Retand/TatI-III
# (Ty3_gypsy/non-chromovirus/OTA/Tat/<leaf> in the shipped HMM) while GyDB has a
# single 'tat'. Both land on clade_h=Tat so the vote is consistent, and the finer
# REXdb call survives in lineage_h. Tatius is NOT in the group: the HMM puts it at
# OTA/Tatius, a sibling of Tat, so it keeps its own clade.
